Product Manager

Location Mirik, Darjeeling
Type On-Site
Team Product & Strategy

Turn Ideas Into Products People Love

Every successful product begins with understanding people.

We're looking for a Product Manager who can bridge the gap between users, business goals, technology, and design. Someone who enjoys solving problems, asking questions, and bringing clarity to complexity.

You'll work closely with designers, developers, researchers, and stakeholders to shape products from concept to launch and beyond.

What You'll Do

  • Define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps.
  • Gather user insights and translate them into product opportunities.
  • Prioritise features based on impact and feasibility.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Create product requirements and user stories.
  • Monitor product performance and identify improvements.
  • Facilitate communication between stakeholders and teams.
  • Drive continuous product innovation and growth.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong product thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to balance user needs with business objectives.
  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
  • Experience managing projects and product workflows.
  • Strategic mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to make decisions in dynamic environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building digital products or SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with user research and product analytics.
  • Background in technology, design, or business strategy.

Why Join Studio 1947?

You'll help shape products that sit at the intersection of design, technology, research, and innovation. You'll work with talented multidisciplinary teams and have the opportunity to influence products from the earliest stages of development.

If you enjoy creating clarity from complexity and transforming ideas into impactful solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready to Apply?

Share your CV, portfolio, product case studies, project experience, or anything that demonstrates how you think, solve problems, and build products.
